name: Story 1: a simple task for another team
description: A member of another team asks for a simple task. I collect the requirements; everything from research to the requester being told is carried by agents and programs, with my approval at each point where something is said or pushed as me. The company's side (checks, AI review, human review, SAIL) is the environment. Time unit: a working hour; horizon four weeks.

machines.name: Me
machines.note: About 60% of my working hours are free for this work; the rest is meetings and duties not modelled.

machines.name: Analyst agent
machines.note: Research, context, stakeholders, runbooks, root cause. Ad hoc sessions.

machines.name: Drafter agent
machines.note: Tickets, PR descriptions, replies, Slack and Jira messages. Everything it writes goes to my outbox.

machines.name: Implementation agents
